### Opening the Seventh Seal
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/opening-the-seventh-seal
Passage: Revelation 8:1-5
Points:
- Heaven halts its ceaseless songs of praise, marking solemn anticipation before the day of divine judgment.
- God quiets the heavenly realm to demonstrate His attentiveness to the prayers of His people.
- The prayers of the saints ascend like incense before being cast to the earth as signs of judgment.
- Believers should never doubt that their prayers are effective and active in God's sovereign plans.

### Prayers of the Apocalypse
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/prayers-of-the-apocalypse
Passage: Revelation 8:1-5
Points:
- Celestial praise falls completely silent as a priestly angel prepares incense before the throne of God.
- The rising incense carries the accumulated cries of suffering saints pleading for divine justice.
- God inaugurates final judgment when altar fire is cast down, answering the long-standing appeals of His people.
- Not a single prayer for God's kingdom to come is forgotten or wasted before His heavenly throne.
